description: The one Honeycrisp window opens the folder Honeycrisp keeps its notes in, chosen on first run and remembered as folder in its settings.md, and bound by Rust before its WebView exists. The page opens it as Honeycrisp's contract client (openDevice from @epicenter/folder/tauri) and passes no path. It lists, reads and writes its folder through the folder plugin's private observation and close channels; on close it waits for queued writes, a note's body included, then destroys the window. It may read the folder's path (folder_path) to ask Epicenter, through the folder plugin, to sync it (epicenter://init) and whether Epicenter already does. It may ask to choose another folder (choose_folder), which opens a native picker and moves the window there. It signs in to nothing.
